title: Two-point selection identity
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a type, let $a:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, choose $\text{plus},\text{minus}\in\Omega$, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}$. Then $a(\text{plus})$ is selected when $x=1$ and $a(\text{minus})$ otherwise, and the selected value is $\frac{a(\text{plus})+a(\text{minus})}{2}+\frac{a(\text{plus})-a(\text{minus})}{2}x$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function a on Ω
Elements plus and minus of Ω
